templates.name: Deliverable issue completeness check
templates.summary: As a calculation, report or drawing package nears issue, the quality reviewer or document controller gets a checklist: missing review records, revisions that disagree between the index, the register and the title block, and citations of out-of-date calculations. Issue stays with the engineers.

templates.name: Design assumption change register
templates.summary: When client criteria or design assumptions change, the project engineer gets one sourced register: what changed, which recorded requirements it touches, how firm each source is, and what still needs confirmation. No design basis is altered.

templates.name: Discipline interface issue register
templates.summary: After a coordination meeting exposes conflicts between disciplines, the design coordinator gets one register: each conflict from the minutes, linked to the clash-export rows and model revisions involved, with the lead who owns each system and the decision still needed. Nothing is resolved.

templates.name: Project experience sheet
templates.summary: For one finished project and one proposal, turn the firm's approved project records into a one-page experience sheet: the firm's role, the scope it performed, partners' work kept apart, and the record behind each line. Names, images and permissions still to confirm are listed for sign-off.

templates.name: RFI review package
templates.summary: The project engineer gets one packet for each request for information: the register entry, the question word for word, the drawing revisions and specification extracts it touches, earlier responses, and a numbered list of what is unresolved. No answer is proposed.

templates.name: Site observation follow-up
templates.summary: After a site visit, the visiting engineer and the project manager get one observation report: each field note beside its location, source photograph, drawing revision and any earlier register entry, a proposed follow-up owner, and the questions still open. It assesses no condition.
